name: codex-offline-web-gateway
author: OpenAI
description: Node.js web gateway runtime for the Codex Offline package

scripts.build:gateway: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('gateway/dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p gateway/tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const dest=path.join('gateway','dist','ipc','codex');fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(path.join('gateway','src','ipc','codex','capabilityContractData.cjs'),path.join(dest,'capabilityContractData.cjs'));fs.copyFileSync(path.join('..','scripts','desktop-patches','plugin-service-compat.cjs'),path.join(dest,'pluginServiceCompat.cjs'));"
